name: Blur: Article Gallery [iOS]
description: An iOS-inspired article gallery template with blurred card backgrounds and a frosted glass feel. Good for editorial app UI demos and news app showcases.

name: Blur: Bubbles
description: A template with soft blurred bubble shapes floating in a looping composition. Works as an ambient background for UI content and visual overlays that need a gentle layered feel.

name: Blur: Bubbles & Carousel
description: A template combining softly blurred bubble shapes in the background with a content carousel in the foreground. Works for lifestyle brand content and UI showcases that need a layered feel.

name: Blur: Logo Switcher
description: A logo switcher template that transitions between marks with a blur. Ideal for brand family presentations and logo evolution showcases.

name: Blur: News Stack [iOS]
description: An iOS-style news card stack template with blurred card backgrounds. Good for editorial and news app UI demos where you want the design to feel considered.

name: Blur: Swirl
description: A swirling blur effect template that distorts content in a circular motion. Works as an atmospheric transition or abstract background element.

name: Counter: Blur
description: A counting animation that sharpens numbers from a soft blur. Great for loading screens and suspenseful reveals.

name: Counter: Bold Poster
description: An oversized counting number in a poster-style layout. Perfect for event promos and bold, graphic animations.

name: Counter: Dotted Circle
description: A bold counter framed by an animated dotted circle. Great for vibrant stat reveals and playful countdowns.

name: Counter: Frosted Glass
description: A frosted glass clock animation. Perfect for sleek countdowns, timers, and premium motion graphics.

name: Counter: Glitch
description: A glitchy digital timer with a flickering, high-tech feel. Ideal for futuristic intros and countdown sequences.

name: Counter: Halftone Poster
description: A large halftone counter styled like a print event poster. Ideal for editorial layouts and graphic countdown designs.

name: Counter: Pixel
description: A pixelated counter rendered on an animated halftone dot grid. Great for retro-style motion graphics and bold poster animations.

name: Counter: Progress Ring
description: A circular progress counter that fills a ring as the percentage climbs. Perfect for loading indicators and stat reveals.
